body.p: Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration of the present application in view of the amendments above and the remarks below.

Claims 1-2 and 4-7 stand as pending in the instant application. Claims 1-2 and 6-9 stand as rejected. Claims 3-5 stand as objected to, but allowable. Applicant has canceled claims 3 and 8-9 herein without prejudice or disclaimer (and reserves the right to pursue patent protection for the subject claims in this application or in one or more continuation applications). Applicant has amended claims 1 and 4-6 herein. No new matter is added by the subject amendments. Support for the amendments is found in the specification, and figures (and related text in the spec.), of the instant application as originally filed, including, but not limited to, at least the following: claims 1 and 3-5 of the instant application as originally filed. Applicant submits that the subject claims are in condition for allowance.

Applicant respectfully acknowledges, and thanks the Examiner for, the indication on page 4 of the pending Office Action, that claims 3-5 are objected to, but would be allowable if rewritten into independent form.
As suggested by the Examiner and as shown in the Claim Listing above, Applicant has amended the claims to include allowable subject matter, as follows:
1. Independent claim 1 is amended to include allowable subject matter of claim 3;
2. Claim 4 has been re-written into independent form to include the language of
claim 1 along with the allowable subject matter of claim 4; and
3. Claim 5 has been re-written into independent form to include the language of
claim 1 along with the allowable subject matter of claim 5.

In view of the above, Applicant respectfully submits that the objection to canceled claim 3 and amended claims 4-5 is rendered as moot and/or has been overcome and that the pending claims are in condition for allowance for at least the above reasons.

On pages 2-4 of the pending Office Action, the Examiner has rejected claims 1-2 and 6-9 under 35 U.S.C. § 102(a)(1) as being allegedly anticipated by U.S. Pat. Pub. No. 2021/0369081 to Kose (hereinafter referred to as the "Kose reference"). In view of the amendments made herein, Applicant respectfully traverses the subject rejection.

Applicant reserves the right to pursue the patentability of the previously presented claims, including claims 1-9, of the instant application in this application or in one or more continuation applications, and to present additional remarks further establishing the patentability thereof.
That said, to move prosecution of the instant application along efficiently and as aforementioned, Applicant has amended independent claim 1 to include allowable subject matter of claim 3.
In view of the above, amended claim 1 is patentable over the cited prior art of record and stands in condition for allowance.
Because claims 2 and 6-7 depend (directly or indirectly) from amended claim 1, and recite additional patentable features, the subject dependent claims are, therefore, likewise patentable.
Applicant has canceled claims 8-9 herein without prejudice or disclaimer such that the pending rejection thereof is rendered as moot.

In view of the above, Applicant submits that the subject § 102 claim rejection is deficient and/or has been rendered as moot, and respectfully requests that the subject § 102 claim rejection be withdrawn accordingly.

Applicant respectfully submits that all of the claims pending in the application meet the requirements for patentability and are in condition for allowance, and respectfully requests that the Examiner indicate the allowance of such claims.

Any amendments to the claims which have been made in this response which have not been specifically noted to overcome a rejection based upon prior art, should be considered to have been made for a purpose unrelated to patentability, and no estoppel should be deemed to attach thereto.
Applicant believes that no fee is due or owed in this matter. If any additional fee is required, please charge same to Deposit Account Number 502456.
Should the Examiner have any questions, the Examiner may contact Applicant's representative at the telephone number below.
Respectfully submitted,
